up your first menu**; otherwise jump to the topic you need.

## The full flow

<Steps>
  <Step title="Sign up and claim your venue">
    Your workspace lives at `rumizi.com/your-venue/w`. Sign-in is
    passwordless — a one-time code or magic link by email or phone, or
    Google and Apple. No password to remember.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Upload your menu">
    Drop a photo, PDF, or a link to your existing menu page. See
    [Upload a menu file](/vendors/menu/upload).
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review and edit">
    Fix prices, group into categories, add photos, and mark items as
    vegetarian, new, or out of stock. See
    [Edit your menu](/vendors/menu/editing).
  </Step>
  <Step title="Publish">
    Nothing is visible to diners until you publish. See
    [Publish and preview](/vendors/menu/publish).
  </Step>
  <Step title="Print your QR code and go">
    Put the QR on tables, windows, and table tents. When someone scans,
    they land on your venue page instantly — no app to install.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Finding your way around the workspace

The workspace header has **Hub**, **Menu**, and **Settings**, plus a
**More** menu holding the rest:

| Where | What's there |
| --- | --- |
| **Hub** | Your workspace home: 7-day stats and least-loved dishes. See [Your Hub](/vendors/workspace/hub). |
| **Menu** | The list of your menus, and the editor. See [Edit your menu](/vendors/menu/editing). |
| **Settings** | Venue profile, brand images, languages, and assistant context. Owner-only. |
| **More → Open live menu** | Your public page, as a diner sees it. |
| **More → Staff** | Invite and manage your team. |
| **More → Gallery** | Every photo your venue uses. See [Gallery](/vendors/media/gallery). |
| **More → Tools** | Website widget and bookmarklet. See [Tools](/vendors/workspace/tools). |
| **More → Billing** | Plans and payment. Owner-only. See [Plans and billing](/vendors/billing/subscription). |
